profile.businessType: A comprehensive Intelligent Digital Solutions Provider, offering consulting services in digital transformation and developing customized solutions tailored to client needs, primarily using AI-assisted Mendix low-code technology. The company also offers a range of AI solutions, including Generative AI and AI Communications Platforms, as well as Debt Collection Systems and Cybersecurity solutions.
profile.address: 54 Bangkok Business Building, Fl. 15, Room No. 1501-1502 Sukhumvit 21 (Asoke) Road, Klong Toey Nua, Wattana Bangkok 10110
profile.dividendPolicy: Not less than 40% of the net profit according to the separate financial statements of the Company after the deduction of taxes and reserves of all types as required by laws and regulations. If there is no other necessity and the dividend payment does not significantly affect the normal operations of the Group. The Board of Directors will consider the dividend payment by considering the interests of the shareholders. The dividend payment is subject to change. It depends on the performance and financial position, liquidity, business expansion plan and any other necessity and suitability in the future and other factors related to the management of the Company
